why: Build fix round 1 for slice 10 of the Reflect ban (0554, ticket 1056) in next/, libfabrika's cloudflare/ folder, on docs/plan/quests/reflect-ban-PLAN.md kind 5, after the review sent the slice back (field/runs/2026-11-16-reflect-ban-s10-review1.json) and the tests round rewrote L8 (3379b4d89). control.ts now exports Payloads, one Effect Schema argument list per callable method (19 project, 8 process, 4 record), and each target's call table maps a name to an entry that decodes the request's args with that payload, failing LedgerError bad_row before any call, then calls client.method(...decoded) with its types checked. The reserved commit check stays before decoding. The private call helper and its Reflect.apply are gone, and so are the methods sets: the tables are typed by Payloads' keys, so the two cannot drift. Schemas reused: Install, CodeEvent's code.failed case, BrainEvent, Start, Activity, ExitReason, From, Chain. Exported from their own modules: Connection (presence/Connections.ts), Sent and Deletion (telemetry/Records.ts), ConnectionId (cloudflare/bindings.ts). The anonymous argument shapes (the hello's trusted caller, a commit's line, a restart request) are private schemas in control.ts. A number argument is Schema.Finite, since JSON carries no other number; an unknown argument is Schema.Json. Two changes outside control.ts were needed: (1) ProcessId's filter could not be sampled by Arbitrary (every draw discarded), so it now carries an arbitraryConstraint pattern taken from a new Id.pattern, which Id.ts's own prefix schemas now use too; the filter still decides. (2) Schema.Tuple([]) for the five no-argument methods crashes lint:promise-types: the TypeScript 7.0.2 API panics on the empty tuple type (interface conversion, TypeReference not TupleType), so those methods use Schema.Array(Schema.Never), which also takes only the empty list.
